gen-gf-revalia-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads with the steadiness of a technical pen. Revalia adds personality with loose, widely spaced letters, while the body's wide-mouthed curves and large middle band keep paragraphs moving smoothly, line after line.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-nobile: A lowercase g with an open lower curve and a relaxed, widely spaced stride gives Revalia its loose swagger. Nobile brings discipline: caps barely above lowercase, mouths like unjoined chalk arcs.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans: Expressive Revalia leads with loose, widely separated letters. Revalia delivers attitude through its open-curved g, while Noto Sans lets its lowercase fill most of the letter height, with a generous c.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Loud and loose: Revalia sprawls its widely separated letters above a body with short ascenders. Noto Sans Balinese keeps breathing space inside every curve, easing the page from shout to text without a jolt.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads sturdy, its midsection swallowing most of the line. Revalia sprawls above it with a loose stride and an open-curved g, so the heading gets room to show off.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-batak: Stubby-pencil sturdiness comes from Noto Sans Batak, with a towering x-height and an e that never squeezes shut. And Revalia does the showing off, with a loose stride and an open-curved g.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-carian: Loose and showy up top, crisp precision underneath. Revalia sprawls across widely separated letters, while Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, a neat counterweight.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Revalia strides along loosely, its widely separated letters sitting in a tall band. Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase toward the caps and leaves the s and c uncrowded, so paragraphs keep moving.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-cham: The body text reads rounded and clean, with generous entry space into every c. Noto Sans Cham handles the reading, while Revalia saves its loose, widely spaced flourish for the heading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Clean texture comes from Noto Sans Coptic, whose middle zone dominates each line, while Revalia sprawls loosely above. Uncrowded s and c mouths keep the text flowing paragraph after paragraph.
